$schema: ERD Entity Schema v2 — Power & Transparency Edition
description: Extended schema for tracking power, money, influence, and accountability of global entities.

fields.name: Display name
fields.category: Sub-category: billionaire, politician, tech_ceo, hedge_fund, lobbying_group, think_tank, ngo, media, military, energy, pharma, etc.
fields.themes: Array: Power, Money, Truth, Peace, Dignity, Knowledge, Renewal, Coordination
fields.whyItMatters: Why this entity matters for understanding power

power_profile.net_worth_usd: Estimated net worth or annual budget (number or null)
power_profile.revenue_usd: Annual revenue for orgs/corps (number or null)
power_profile.power_type: Array: financial, political, military, cultural, technological, informational
power_profile.influence_regions: Array of regions/countries where entity has significant influence
power_profile.key_positions: Array of positions held: {title, org, from, to}
power_profile.media_ownership: Array of media outlets owned or controlled

network.allies: Array of entity IDs with relationship type
network.controls: Array of entity IDs (subsidiaries, controlled orgs)

accountability.transparency_score: 1-10 (how transparent is this entity about its actions)
accountability.source_quality: high | medium | low (how well-sourced is our data)

judgment.dimensions: Object with scored dimensions like Peace, Dignity, Freedom, Knowledge, Truth contribution
